subject.title: exec private-LAN access fails while same user GUI/LaunchAgent succeeds

question: Should this issue be resolved by the diagnostic-only exec warning in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94045, or should OpenClaw pursue actual gateway-host private-LAN reachability parity?
rationale: Source inspection can prove the missing diagnostic and the linked PR's scope, but it cannot safely choose whether private-LAN exec traffic should remain blocked, be detached from the gateway process context, or gain new policy controls.

options.title: Land Diagnostic Only
options.body: Review and land the diagnostic PR, leaving private-network reachability and SSRF policy changes to the related security trackers.

options.title: Design Access Parity
options.body: Treat same-user GUI/LaunchAgent reachability as the product goal and require a separate security design before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Platform Tracker
options.body: Close or defer this after explicitly moving the remaining macOS LaunchAgent/Tailscale-Funnel caveat to the broader platform tracker.

recommendation.title: Land Diagnostic Only
recommendation.body: Review and land the diagnostic PR, leaving private-network reachability and SSRF policy changes to the related security trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined history across exec outcome formatting, Codex app-server guard ownership, and macOS gateway-host surfaces.
